DLC2318:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have found that the way of the warrior is death...」

DLC2318:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「These words describe the samurai's way of life. They certainly do not encourage death.」

DLC2318:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then how should a man live when he has lost the place where he meant to die...?」

DLC2318:3:t_1:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The tale I am about to tell takes place just after the decisive battle with $$アマルガム$$.」

DLC2318:3:t_1:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「With even fiercer battles ahead, what thoughts occupy this man who has lived as a samurai?」

DLC2318:3:t_1:13.en:
$$グラハム$$
（$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ declared this world... its past... a mistake, and tried to start it all over...）

DLC2318:3:t_1:15.en:
$$グラハム$$
（Young man. What sort of world lies in the future you are heading toward...?）

DLC2318:3:t_1:16.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「You're a maiden in love.」

DLC2318:3:t_1:18.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Watching from the shadows, shooting him those passionate, sorrowful looks... If an old comrade of mine saw you now, I'm sure that's what he'd say.」

DLC2318:3:t_1:19.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I certainly am a Virgo, but... Am I really so unmanly?」

DLC2318:3:t_1:20.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「That is not how I would put it. But...」

DLC2318:3:t_1:21.en:
$$グラハム$$
「No... I can hardly blame you for saying it. Even I cannot help laughing at my own lack of courage.」

DLC2318:3:t_1:22.en:
$$スザク$$
「You still can't hold your head high?」

DLC2318:3:t_1:23.en:
$$グラハム$$
「That is how much his presence means to me. That incident made me realize it all over again.」

DLC2318:3:t_1:25.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「You were with a different team at the time, $$スザク$$.」

DLC2318:3:t_1:26.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「It happened after $c returned from $$翠の地球$$ to $$蒼の地球$$, when we'd split into three teams...」

DLC2318:3:t_2:4.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「$$ルイス$$! Is that you, $$ルイス・ハレヴィ$$!?」

DLC2318:3:t_2:6.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's not right, is it?」

DLC2318:3:t_2:7.en:
$$ルイス$$
「Oh, of course. Lieutenant Happily Married $$マネキン$$.」

DLC2318:3:t_2:8.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「You get full marks.」

DLC2318:3:t_2:9.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「And that must be the guy I've heard so much about...」

DLC2318:3:t_2:10.en:
$$沙慈$$
「I'm $$沙慈・クロスロード$$. $$ルイス$$ has told me about you, Lieutenant.」

DLC2318:3:t_2:11.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
（Sorry, $$アンドレイ$$. Looks like there isn't the tiniest opening for you here.）

DLC2318:3:t_2:12.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「So, you two... Are you off on your honeymoon in times as dangerous as these?」

DLC2318:3:t_2:13.en:
$$沙慈$$
「That's not exactly it, but $$ルイス$$'s symptoms have started to settle down, so...」

DLC2318:3:t_2:14.en:
$$ルイス$$
「$$沙慈$$ fulfilled his dream of working in space, so I've decided to move to a colony and live with him.」

DLC2318:3:t_2:15.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「So it is a honeymoon after all! Congratulations!」

DLC2318:3:t_2:16.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「What do you make of this?」

DLC2318:3:t_2:17.en:
$$グラハム$$
「We should probably consider it an extension of the abductions the Empire has been carrying out on Earth.」

DLC2318:3:t_2:18.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Gathering people for use in the $$霊子吸収システム$$...」

DLC2318:3:t_2:19.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「That must be their motive, but it does not explain why they singled out this shuttle.」

DLC2318:3:t_2:20.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Are you suggesting the Empire can now identify people suited to the system in advance...?」

DLC2318:3:t_2:21.en:
$$ルイス$$
「...Excuse me, but you're $$ミスター・ブシドー$$, aren't you?」

DLC2318:3:t_2:22.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I fight under the name $$グラハム・エーカー$$ now. ...I am glad to see you looking well, too.」

DLC2318:3:t_2:24.en:
$$グラハム$$
「We never spoke directly, but I saw you several times when we were in $$アロウズ$$.」

DLC2318:3:t_2:25.en:
$$グラハム$$
「The light in your eyes is different from back then.」

DLC2318:3:t_2:28.en:
$$ルイス$$
「Yes. I can't feel that wall you used to put up between yourself and everyone around you.」

DLC2318:3:t_2:30.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Maybe it's because of where we are, but I can hardly believe you're the same person who chased $$刹那$$ across the battlefield.」

DLC2318:3:t_2:31.en:
$$グラハム$$
「You know about the days when I was called Bushido?」

DLC2318:3:t_2:32.en:
$$沙慈$$
「$$ルイス$$ told me about you.」

DLC2318:3:t_2:33.en:
$$沙慈$$
「During the $$再世戦争$$, I was part of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$, riding in $$刹那$$'s $$ダブルオーライザー$$.」

DLC2318:3:t_2:34.en:
$$グラハム$$
「You were with that young man...」

DLC2318:3:t_2:35.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Meeting $$刹那$$ changed you too, didn't it?」

DLC2318:3:t_2:36.en:
$$グラハム$$
「The way you say that... Did it change you as well?」

DLC2318:3:t_2:37.en:
$$沙慈$$
「$$ルイス$$ and I... and the world, too... We all changed through our encounters with $$刹那$$ and $$ソレスタルビーイング$$.」

DLC2318:3:t_2:39.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「The Empire still hasn't given up!?」

DLC2318:3:t_2:40.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Let us go! We cannot let them take these people!」

DLC2318:3:t_2:42.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Leave the fighting to us. You protect her.」

DLC2318:3:t_2:43.en:
$$グラハム$$
「And someday... if we have the chance, tell me about that young man... $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$.」

DLC2318:3:t_3:4.en:
$$スザク$$
「...I'd heard that $$沙慈$$ and the others had been abducted, but I didn't know all that had happened.」

DLC2318:3:t_3:5.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I am sorry, $$スザク$$. I understand they are your friends as well.」

DLC2318:3:t_3:6.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Hold on. I'm the one who was assigned to guard that shuttle. I should be the one apologizing.」

DLC2318:3:t_3:7.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Even so... I want to apologize.」

DLC2318:3:t_3:8.en:
$$スザク$$
「...You're the same, Major $$グラハム$$. Just like me... and $$ルルーシュ$$.」

DLC2318:3:t_3:10.en:
$$スザク$$
「You carry guilt somewhere in your heart, and it never stops tormenting you...」

DLC2318:3:t_3:11.en:
$$スザク$$
「I'm sure that's true of $$刹那$$ too, after intervening in conflicts all over the world with $$ソレスタルビーイング$$.」

DLC2318:3:t_3:12.en:
$$グラハム$$
「You are saying that young man... is the same as me?」

DLC2318:3:t_3:14.en:
$$グラハム$$
「But he shows no hesitation. He pursues his mission with unwavering devotion...」

DLC2318:3:t_3:15.en:
$$スザク$$
「I think that's exactly what we're being asked to do.」

DLC2318:3:t_3:17.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$スザク$$ is right, Major.」

DLC2318:3:t_3:18.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Neither we nor he can be allowed to forget our past sins. But if we are to live on and fight in shame, we must move beyond them.」

review.context: Graham reflects after Amalgam; his comrades recall protecting Saji and Louise on a shuttle, then urge him to carry his guilt while still moving forward.
decisions: Colasour invokes a comrade when teasing Graham, while Graham answers with the Virgo/maiden pun.
Lieutenant Happily Married Mannequin retains the source married-name joke rather than using Colasour as his corrected surname.
